# onlinesourdough

> Practical ways for solo founders and small teams to make data and AI useful in everyday work.

The site shares The Onlinesourdough Method, free resources, and ongoing 1:1 collaboration through The Fermentary.

- Home: https://onlinesourdough.com/
- About and the method: https://onlinesourdough.com/about/
- The Fermentary: https://onlinesourdough.com/fermentary/
- Resources: https://resources.onlinesourdough.com/
- Arc'IT AI custom projects: https://arcitai.com/
- Gustav Anderson: https://gustavonline.com/
